messages:
elaine_sales: Heads-up: NewRelic Co. procurement requires the invoice line to contain department codes and their internal SKU `NR-LLM-MON`. They want the committed discount to apply immediately for the POC start.
mike_dealdesk: If the PO uses their internal SKU we need either a Private Offer that includes that SKU mapping or we do manual attribution. Private Offer is preferred for audits but takes time.
chris_finance: Finance note: manual attribution possible but needs signed buyer ack and a 45-day window for retro credits. Also need GL codes: REV_MARKET_01, CREDIT_RETRO_01.
sam_se: Technically marketplace metering ties to offer_id + sku. If their template doesn't let them include our sku, we'll lose automated commit detection. We can supply a mapping note to accounting but it still won't show up on marketplace invoices.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: Creating Azure/AWS Private Offer requires partner enablement and offer config. ETA 48-72 hours after approval.
mike_dealdesk: Drafting exception: "Redwood will accept PO referencing customer SKU NR-LLM-MON and will manually attribute usage to the committed marketplace SKU for Apr 2026. A one-time credit will be issued if marketplace metering fails to attribute, subject to a $25k cap and 45-day claim window. Customer must sign acknowledgement."
elaine_sales: Customer says they can sign ack now and need POC this week. They prefer we accept PO as-is.
chris_finance: Finance will approve manual attribution with signed ack and cap. Accounting requires the signed ack prior to issuing any credit.
mike_dealdesk: I'll send to legal for the short exception clause (audit + cap + ack). If legal approves we accept PO and log manual attribution in the deal notes. If legal rejects, we trigger Private Offer flow.
sam_se: I'll attach the SKU mapping snippet for accounting to use during reconciliation.
sam_se: SKU mapping: offer_id: offer_az_02 | marketplace_sku: redwood.marketplace.nr.v1 | customer_label: NR-LLM-MON | notes: manual attribution for Apr commit.
mike_dealdesk: Legal approved with minor edits. Deal desk approves one-time manual attribution. Action items: 1) elaine_sales upload signed ack + PO, 2) chris_finance confirm GL codes and credit cap in accounting ticket, 3) sam_se add mapping to billing notes.
elaine_sales: Uploaded signed ack and PO. Going to confirm start date with customer. Thanks all. :tada:
